purpose: Bind the generated facade sill-drainage assembly to the formal reflection-probe epoch. A genuinely missing fallback sill pass may be prepared before the first reflection baseline; after that baseline is armed, all request/poll/completion/pre-still checks are read-only and fail closed on root replacement/deletion, authored/fallback mode changes, legacy-sill re-enablement, or structural/material/LOD/topology drift. This contract awards no Visual Fidelity points.
limitations: This binding proves reflection-epoch coherence only; it does not prove that the reconstructed sill dimensions are visually correct at benchmark distance.
Read-only post-arm validation cannot prove that drain openings read as physical recesses rather than overly dark holes in final pixels.
A stable root instance and passing structural QA cannot prove that anodized-aluminum Fresnel response, highlight width or contact shadowing are filmic under the actual midsummer lighting state.
The binding cannot clear visible_lod_pop or severe_aliasing_or_shimmer; native-4K temporal evidence remains mandatory.
Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime behavior remains unverified until a real Runner executes the reflection request, poll, completion and pre-still sequence.
